主要内容: On July 9, 2018, HENRY SCHEIN INC reported in its 8-K filing that it is currently unable to estimate the amount or range of costs expected to be incurred in connection with certain activities. The company stated it will file an amendment to the Current Report on Form 8-K once it determines such estimates. The filing was signed by Walter Siegel, Senior Vice President and General Counsel. The Company also committed to an initiative to rationalize its operations and provide expense efficiencies, with these activities expected to be complete by the end of 2018.
